sources.quote: Laptop, tent, and tablet modes supported by 360 degree sound-bar hinge
3x Thunderbolt 4, with USB PD 45-65W and DisplayPort 2.1, Always On

notes: AXIS MAPPING: Lenovo publishes closed-state Dimensions (WxDxH) = 315.09 x 209.5 x 15.5 mm; manufacturer WIDTH 315.09 -> closed.width, manufacturer DEPTH 209.5 -> closed.height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness 15.5 -> closed.depth. closed.width is the LONG axis, opposite the phone-vendor convention. dimensions_mm.open null - no opened dimension published. mass_g from 'Starting at 1.219 kg' x 1000 = 1219 g exactly; STARTING weight. THIS IS THE CURRENT / NEWEST Yoga Book 9i generation as of 2026-09-13: the PSREF document itself is dated September 04 2026, and probing PSREF for a Gen 11 (Yoga_Book_9_14IAH11, Yoga_Book_9_14IMH11, Yoga_Book_9_14AHP10) returned HTTP 404 for all, so only Gen 8 / Gen 9 / Gen 10 exist. Screen size grew from 13.3in (Gen 8/9) to 14in and refresh from 60Hz to 120Hz. TWO DISCRETE PANELS, roles primary + secondary, identical. PSREF also states screen-to-body 'B Cover: 94.37% AAR, C Cover: 94.67% AAR' - i.e. the two panels have marginally different active-area ratios, but Lenovo publishes no per-cover active-area millimetres, so active_area_mm is derived identically for both from the sourced diagonal + resolution assuming square pixels: 14.0 x 2880 / sqrt(2880^2+1800^2) x 25.4 = 301.5 mm wide, 188.5 mm high. Brightness is 750nits HDR peak / 500nits SDR typical. hinge.axis 'long' read from the sound-bar hinge geometry. PORTS: 3x Thunderbolt 4 recorded as usb_c per SPEC's port enum; no headphone jack, no HDMI; position null (PSREF callouts are image labels). materials.cover_glass null - PSREF names no cover glass product. released null - Lenovo's CES 2025 press kit gives no full release date.
